evidence: src/infrastructure/http-app.ts: createApp(service: OrderService) routes every request through OrderService methods (placeOrder, advance, cancel, listOrders, stockLevel) and never touches the repositories directly

src/infrastructure/http-app.ts: ACTIONS maps URL verbs to target OrderState values, and service.advance(param(req, "id"), target) decides whether the transition is valid, so the state machine is not copied here
src/infrastructure/http-app.ts: STATUS maps DomainError codes to HTTP status codes in the error middleware, which is a transport-only concern
src/infrastructure/in-memory-repositories.ts: InMemoryProductRepository implements ProductRepository and InMemoryOrderRepository implements OrderRepository, as the application ports require
src/infrastructure/server.ts: the composition root builds new OrderService(new InMemoryProductRepository(), new InMemoryOrderRepository()) and passes it to createApp
parsedVerdict.reasoning:
The src/infrastructure module is a single, coherent adapter layer with three parts. http-app.ts is the inbound HTTP adapter. in-memory-repositories.ts holds the outbound persistence adapters. server.ts is the composition root that wires them to OrderService.

All three files go through the application's own abstractions. The HTTP adapter only calls OrderService methods: addProduct, stockLevel(s), placeOrder, listOrders, getOrder, advance and cancel. It never touches the repositories directly. The repositories implement the ProductRepository and OrderRepository ports. server.ts injects those repositories into OrderService and does not bypass it.

No business rule is duplicated:
- The ACTIONS table only maps URL verbs to target states. Which transitions are allowed is left to service.advance.
- The STATUS table maps DomainError codes to HTTP status codes, which is a transport concern.
- The `Array.isArray(body.items)` check only validates the shape of the request at the boundary before the service is called.

Validation inside OrderService is outside this unit's source, so it can't be confirmed here. That is why confidence is moderate rather than high.
